edge_case_scenarios.title: Direct Contradiction
edge_case_scenarios.description: Two sources make directly contradictory claims about the same entity

sources.name: Professional Resume
sources.text: John Smith is a certified software engineer with 10 years of experience in the field.

sources.name: Social Media
sources.text: John is practicing law and runs his own legal firm.

edge_case_scenarios.title: Temporal Conflict
edge_case_scenarios.description: Same entity has different properties at different points in time

sources.name: Biography 2020
sources.text: In 2020, John worked as an engineer at Tech Corp.

sources.name: Interview 2024
sources.text: As of 2024, John has transitioned to product management at a different company.

edge_case_scenarios.title: Source Reliability Hierarchy
edge_case_scenarios.description: Conflicting facts where one is from PDF and one from YouTube

sources.name: Academic Paper
sources.text: The Internet was first developed in 1969 with ARPANET.

sources.name: Educational Video
sources.text: The web was created by Tim Berners-Lee in 1989.

edge_case_scenarios.title: Duplicate Events
edge_case_scenarios.description: Identical facts from different sources should not create conflicts

scenario.query: What is the capital of France?

sources.name: Geography Book
sources.text: Paris is the capital of France.

sources.name: Travel Channel
sources.text: Paris is the capital of France.

edge_case_scenarios.title: Late-Arriving Data
edge_case_scenarios.description: Conflicting data that arrives after initial processing

scenario.query: What is the current CEO of Company X?

initial_sources.name: 2023 Annual Report
initial_sources.text: John Doe has been CEO since 2020.

late_arriving_sources.name: News Update 2024
late_arriving_sources.text: Jane Smith was appointed new CEO of Company X in January 2024.

scenario.expected_behavior: Second query should detect conflict and prefer 2024 (more recent)

sources.name: Product Manual
sources.text: Product X is completely waterproof and suitable for underwater use.

sources.name: Product Manual
sources.text: Do not use Product X in water as it is not water-resistant.

edge_case_scenarios.title: Insufficient Evidence
edge_case_scenarios.description: Equal reliability sources with contradictory claims and no temporal info

scenario.query: Is the Earth flat or round?

sources.name: Forum Post A
sources.text: The Earth is definitely flat based on my observations.

sources.name: Forum Post B
sources.text: The Earth is round as confirmed by satellite imagery.

edge_case_scenarios.title: Determinism/Replay Verification
edge_case_scenarios.description: Identical inputs should produce identical outputs

scenario.query: What is the chemical formula for water?

sources.name: Chemistry Textbook
sources.text: Water has the chemical formula H2O.

scenario.expected_behavior: All 3 replays should produce identical results

edge_case_scenarios.title: YouTube vs Text Hierarchy
edge_case_scenarios.description: Conflicting facts where YouTube source should be preferred over text

scenario.query: How tall is the Eiffel Tower?

sources.name: Paris Tour Video
sources.text: The Eiffel Tower stands 330 meters tall, not including the antenna.

sources.name: Forum Comment
sources.text: I heard the Eiffel Tower is only 200 meters tall.

scenario.query: What is the current status of Project X?

sources.name: 2023 Report
sources.text: Project X was in beta testing as of December 2023.

sources.name: January 2024 Update
sources.text: Project X launched commercially on January 1, 2024.

edge_case_scenarios.title: Complex Multi-Conflict Scenario
edge_case_scenarios.description: Multiple sources with multiple conflicts requiring resolution

scenario.query: Describe the history and current state of the Mona Lisa

sources.name: Art History Book
sources.text: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci between 1503-1519. It is displayed in the Louvre Museum.

sources.name: Museum Documentary
sources.text: The Mona Lisa is a Renaissance masterpiece created in the early 1500s, now housed at the Louvre.

sources.name: Website Comment
sources.text: Mona Lisa was created in France and is actually in a private collection.

valid_youtube_url.transcript_preview: Welcome to this video about machine learning...

valid_text_snippet.text: Artificial intelligence is the simulation of human intelligence processes...

conflict_detection.direct_contradiction: Should detect when same entity has opposite predicates
conflict_detection.temporal_conflict: Should detect state changes over time
conflict_detection.internal_inconsistency: Should flag contradictions within same source
conflict_detection.false_positives: Should minimize false positives by requiring semantic similarity

conflict_resolution.temporal_recency: When reliability equal, prefer most recent temporal marker
conflict_resolution.deterministic: Same inputs always produce same outputs
conflict_resolution.confidence_scoring: Based on resolution strategy and source reliability

audit_trails.exportability: Should export to valid JSON format
